title: U.S. Stocks Slide on Middle East Tensions; Dow Falls 464 Points as Oil Hits $83
summary: The Dow Jones dropped 464 points (0.85%) to 53,885 on August 6, while the S&P 500 fell 0.2% and the Nasdaq lost 0.1%. Escalating Middle East tensions and lack of clarity on a Strait of Hormuz deal pushed Brent crude to $83/bbl, reviving inflation fears and sending 8 of 11 S&P sectors into the red.
why: 中东局势令油价急升冲击股市，美债收益率走高，恐加重美联储9月加息预期；若原油持续高位，持仓隐含波动率或再度走阔，sell put须谨慎管控行权价风险敞口。

title: U.S. July Jobs Report: Nonfarm Payrolls +83K, Below ~95K Estimate; Unemployment Steady at 4.2%
summary: The BLS reported July nonfarm payrolls rose 83,000, below the ~95,000 consensus and the first-half 2026 average of 92,000/month. Unemployment held at 4.2% (vs. forecast of 4.3%). The weak print eases some pressure for Fed rate hikes but elevated oil prices remain an inflation wildcard ahead of the September FOMC.
why: 就业数据低于预期，短期缓解市场对美联储9月加息的担忧；但中东油价高企形成通胀对冲，美联储政策路径仍不明朗；数据公布后市场隐含波动率预期收敛，对期权卖方策略短期略为有利。

title: A股8月7日反弹：沪指涨1.02%，创业板涨1.35%，医药CRO及PCB板块领涨
summary: 沪指低开高走，收涨1.02%；创业板指涨1.35%，深成指涨1.42%。盘面上医药CRO板块掀涨停潮，PCB概念股强势，再鼎医药涨超18%，全市场涨停74家、最高4板，市场情绪较前一日明显回暖。
why: A股整体反弹，科技与医药板块领涨，前期恐慌性抛盘已有所消化；PCB赛道与AI应用板块持续强势，与英伟达/高盛上调AI服务器预测呼应；板块轮动加速对期权策略布局有参考意义。

title: 港股8月7日收涨：恒指+0.54%，科技指数+0.78%，AI应用与生物医药板块领涨
summary: 恒生指数收涨0.54%，恒生科技指数涨0.78%，国企指数涨0.39%。PCB概念股强势，建滔积层板涨逾9%；AI应用股活跃，智谱涨超14%；生物医药大涨，再鼎医药涨超18%；新股拿森科技上市首日涨超64%，市场整体随A股同步反弹。
why: 港股三大指数随A股反弹而回升，科网板块整体小幅走强；腾讯8月12日发布Q2业绩前可能出现波动，各主要持仓的sell put持仓需留意时间价值侵蚀与盈利公告窗口期风险。

title: Palantir Q2 2026 Blowout: Revenue +93% to $1.94B, Full-Year Guidance Raised; PLTR Surges ~30%
summary: Palantir reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.935 billion (+93% YoY), beating consensus by ~$123M. Adjusted EPS of $0.41 exceeded the $0.35 estimate. U.S. commercial revenue surged 149% to $764M; U.S. government revenue rose 90% to $809M. Full-year guidance raised to $8.15-8.16B (from $7.65B). Stock surged ~30% on Aug 4; short sellers lost ~$3B in paper gains.
why: Palantir Q2爆发式增长验证企业AI落地变现，已上市企业合同签约量连续刷新记录，是AI实物落地进展的最佳观测窗口；持仓PLTR者需注意大涨后期权隐含波动率被大量消化，sell put成本收益比已大幅改变；同时印证AI赛道逻辑继续有效。

title: SanDisk & SK Hynix Unveil First High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) Industry Standard at FMS 2026
summary: At the Future of Memory and Storage Conference (Santa Clara, Aug 4-6), SanDisk and SK Hynix released the first OCP High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) specification — offering up to 512GB capacity at 0.4–3.0 TB/s bandwidth. HBF is positioned between DRAM HBM and SSDs for AI inference workloads, expanding the addressable AI memory market across both DRAM and NAND vendors.
why: HBF标准化开创AI推理内存赛道新品类，闪迪(SNDK)与SK海力士均为持仓标的，新标准若获行业广泛采纳（Google/Tenstorrent已加入联盟）将扩展AI存储市场空间；延续报道：FMS 2026大会于8月4-6日举行，标准公告发布后在业界持续引发关注。

title: Disney Q3 FY2026 Beats: Adj. EPS $2.06 vs $1.86 Est.; Parks Hit Record $9.97B Revenue
summary: Walt Disney reported fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended June 27) adjusted EPS of $2.06, beating $1.86 consensus. Total revenue was $25.25B (+7% YoY, slightly below $25.4B est.). Experiences (parks & cruises) revenue rose 10% to a record $9.97B; streaming revenue grew 11% to $5.53B, boosted by Toy Story 5. Total segment operating income rose 21% YoY.
why: 迪士尼乐园营收破历史纪录、流媒体利润率持续提升，DIS主业基本面扎实；EPS大超预期但营收略低于预估，关注管理层全年展望指引——若全年EPS指引上调将进一步支撑估值；DIS持仓者可评估covered call的行权价是否因大涨后的隐含波动率回落而需要调整。

title: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8-Max: 2.4T-Parameter AI Claims Benchmark Parity with Anthropic's Fable 5
summary: Alibaba unveiled Qwen3.8-Max on Aug 3 — a 2.4 trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (95B active parameters), 1M-token context window, priced at ~40% of Claude Fable 5 for input tokens. It topped Chinese model rankings on Arena.AI for text and ranked second globally for vision tasks. Open-weight release expected within days.
why: Qwen3.8-Max将阿里AI能力提升至媲美Anthropic的新台阶，阿里云竞争力强化有助于巩固中国AI基础设施定价权；BABA/9988持仓者关注本轮AI估值重估能否抵消AliExpress欧盟5.5亿欧元罚款的短期冲击；延续报道：开源版本本周如期发布将进一步提升市场讨论热度。

title: SanDisk Q4 FY2026 Blowout: Revenue $8.97B (+51% QoQ), EPS $39.25 Beats $33.38 Est.; SNDK +8%
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) reported fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $8.97 billion, surging 51% sequentially — roughly two-thirds from higher NAND pricing, one-third from higher volumes. Non-GAAP EPS of $39.25 beat the $33.38 consensus by 17.6%. Revenue topped SanDisk's own guided range of $7.75-8.25B. SNDK stock rose ~8% in reaction; Micron (MU) gained 6%, SK Hynix 4%.
why: 闪迪Q4业绩大超预期，NAND价格与出货量双升印证AI驱动的存储超级周期仍在持续；SNDK持仓者在大涨后评估是否卖出covered call；同步带动美光(MU)与SK海力士上涨，说明赛道基本面的集体改善；但前瞻指引「未清楚给出超高增长延续信号」或引发高预期下的市场分歧。

title: Tencent (0700.HK) to Report Q2 2026 Results Aug 12; Options Imply Elevated Volatility Pre-Print
summary: Tencent's board convenes August 12 to approve and release Q2 2026 interim results. Analysts forecast steady gaming growth (Honor of Kings, Delta Force) but focus is on AI monetization clarity and H2 capex guidance. The stock is in a buyback blackout period. Options-implied move is elevated ahead of the print; analysts rate it Hold with a $76/share (OTC) target.
why: 腾讯Q2业绩8月12日公布，为本周最重要的港股催化事件；若AI货币化进展或H2资本开支指引不及市场预期，股价可能短期承压——sell put持仓者须关注行权价保护，结果公布前隐含波动率偏高对期权买方略有利；建议持仓者提前规划处置方案。
